quotations.old_english: Dú meahtest ðé fullrecen on ðæm ródere ufan siððan weorþan
quotations.english: thou, very quick, mayest afterwards advance into the sky above

source_text: full-recen; adj. Full quick, very quick; citiss&i-short;mus :-- Dú meahtest ðé fullrecen on ðæm ródere ufan siððan weorþan thou, very quick, mayest afterwards advance into the sky above, Bt. Met. Fox 24, 33; Met. 24, 17.
